description.ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199』物語の序盤のみどころ“メ号作戦”を再現できる 1/1000スケールプラモデル２２隻＋αが

description.en: How are these three ships related to “Operation Me”? ! ? Everything is revealed in the included "Settings Booklet"!

description.ja: • HOW TOなどの記事を含む｢設定小冊子｣付属！

description.ja: • 豪華箔押し仕様の‘スペシャルボックス’仕様！
description.en: • ‘Special box’ specification with luxurious foil stamping!
